A knife easily penetrates the grandpa's stout belly.
It's only the first time she's killing a human,
yet it turned out to be rather exciting.
As his eyes roll up, grandpa falls,
「I wanted to do this for so very long.
Before she can return to grandma, Red Hood first
should feed the meat to the wolf. To make it easier
to carry, she slices it into neat cubes.
With this…the peace must return into her life.
A calm and confident smile appeared on the girl's
face, for the first time in a long while.
